items.title: How Will Nucor Stock React To Its Upcoming Earnings?
items.summary: Nucor (NYSE:NUE) is scheduled to report its earnings on Monday, October 26, 2026. The company has a market value of about $58.9 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $36.1 billion in revenue and $4.2 billion in operating profit, with net income of $2.9 billion.
